name: safepay
summary: The payables firewall for AI agents: policy in plain words, live-web merchant check and intent reasoning before any PayPal or stablecoin (PYUSD, USDC) payment moves, a remote MCP connector any agent asks before it pays, human approvals (console, MCP, Telegram), a kill switch per agent, signed receipts and a hash-chained audit log.
author: NovaCorp Labs
